Payment Terms: when and how must the invoices be paid
the price, the payment schedule and late payment interest
how many days does the buyer have to pay
Delivery: when and where will the goods or services be delivered
who pays for shipping and who carries the risk in transit
delivery deadlines and acceptance of the delivered goods
Confidentiality: what information must be kept secret
is there a non-disclosure obligation between the parties
how long does the duty of confidentiality last
Indemnification: who has to compensate the other party for losses or third-party claims
one party holds the other harmless against damages
Termination For Breach: can a party end the contract if the other party breaks it
termination for material breach and the time to cure it
what happens when one side fails to perform its obligations
Force Majeure: events beyond the parties' control that excuse performance
relief from liability for natural disasters, war or other extraordinary events
what happens if performance is prevented by circumstances nobody could foresee
Dispute Resolution: how are disagreements between the parties settled
arbitration, mediation or court proceedings for disputes
the steps the parties must follow before going to court
Data Protection: how is personal data handled and protected
obligations under privacy and data protection law such as GDPR
who processes personal data and for what purposes
